fusions.name: Hurled Nest
fusions.desc: Hurls a live nest at a target up to 7 tiles away for 12 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach. It knocks the target back 2.5 tiles and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Mobbing Knuckles
fusions.desc: A punch that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. It hits 10% harder for each ally near you, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Chest-Beat Lure
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. A swarm fights beside you for 7 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Roused Troop
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, your physical damage rises by 40% for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
